books.title: Pig that wouldn't listen
books.author: Zanele Mguye
books.description: This cheeky pig doesn't want to listen to the farmer!

books.title: Pink and Blue
books.author: Fulufhelo Bulala
books.description: How can it be wrong for a boy to like the colour pink? (The storybook was originally created on the African Storybook Maker App, and then re-published on the website. It was originally created at a storybook development workshop with 22 educators, in February 2019, in partnership with the British Council and Department of Basic Education, South Africa).

books.title: Pontshibobo's tree (Colour-in)
books.author: African Storybook
books.description: Colour-in version. This story teaches us about true friendship.

books.title: Rain for Nomvula
books.author: Nolitha Bikitsha
books.description: Nomvula wants to play - but first it is too hot, and then it is too wet. She discovers it is fun to play in the rain.

books.title: Rainbow Fish
books.author: Diana Tebeila
books.description: Fish once had no colours. This story explains how fish became colourful. The storybook was created in 2022 as part of a collaborative project involving African Storybook, British Council (South Africa), and Department of Basic Education (DBE SA)

books.title: Ramuramu the goat
books.author: Olajide Akoni
books.description: Ramúramù' is a Yoruba expression for "roaring." Ramuramu the goat runs away, only to find out that the safest and friendliest place to be is home. (This story was created at a Story Making Workshop in Abuja, 2018, co-hosted by African Storybook and the British Council Nigeria).

books.title: Rats in the Barn
books.author: Angela Doo Kamnan HHA Writing Workshop
books.description: Rats can cause much damage to crops and also cause dangerous diseases. Children need to learn ways of keeping them away from where we live.

books.title: Rats!
books.author: Little Zebra Books
books.description: A man makes oil in his house. Rats want this oil. They come up with a plan to steal the oil. Will they succeed?

books.title: Result of famine
books.author: Bashir Usman
books.description: Famine can lead to stealing, even from the mother-in-law, which is the most taboo thing in Fulve culture. (This story was created at a Story Making Workshop in Abuja, 2018, co-hosted by African Storybook and the British Council Nigeria).

books.title: Rooster and Leopard
books.author: Yikii Kubbi Emmanuel
books.description: Rooster was king of the animals until the leopards discovered his trick.

books.title: Sakima's song
books.author: Ursula Nafula
books.description: A boy with visual impairment sings wonderfully and consoles a very rich man. Find out how he is rewarded.

books.title: Salemka'an spends her day with wind
books.author: Mimi Werna
books.description: Salemka'an experiences the power of wind.

books.title: Secret agent
books.author: Linda Liphondo
books.description: When Dr Devious kidnaps Kay's parents, she is determined to get them back. (Story and illustrations created by children at a July 2019 holiday workshop, facilitated by African Storybook at Pimville Library in Soweto).

books.title: Sheep who got tired of city life
books.author: Mohammed Alhaji Modu
books.description: In whatever situation you find yourself, get ready for challenges and be claver and self-reliant. (This story was created at a Story Making Workshop in Abuja, 2018, co-hosted by African Storybook and the British Council Nigeria).

books.title: Shepherd and his best friend
books.author: Biniam Asfaw
books.description: A young shepherd is saved from danger by his fury best friend. What danger was he facing? Read and find out!

books.title: Sifiso preserves mangos
books.author: Mduduzi Benjie Shongwe
books.description: Storybook introduces the idea of preserving fruit and vegetables, with a focus on mangos (also spelled: mangoes). The story was inspired by 'Hashim saves the mangoes', published on StoryWeaver. (The writing and publishing of this storybook was made possible by funding from the Oppenheimer Memorial Trust).

books.title: Sima and Siza
books.author: Lwando Xaso
books.description: Sima wants to be a nurse one day. His favourite game is hospital-hospital. But papa and his friends do not approve. What will change their minds?

books.title: Singing the truth: The story of Miriam Makeba
books.author: Jade Mathieson
books.description: Learn about the amazing life of a little girl who grew up to use her gift of singing to help bring freedom to South Africa.

books.title: Soccer star
books.author: David M
books.description: A boy's precious gift from his father helps him to become a soccer star. (This story was created at a holiday programme run by Sophiatown Community Psychological Services in Johannesburg, July 2018.).

books.title: Sofia escapes
books.author: Neema Wambui
books.description: Curiosity leads a little girl into trouble.

books.title: Sun and Rain
books.author: Annet Ssebaggala
books.description: Can you tell the good and bad effects of rain and sunshine? What is more powerful?
books.illustrator: Wiehan de Jager, Marleen Visser, Catherine Groenewald, Melany Pietersen, Jesse Breytenbach, Genevieve Terblanche

books.title: Sun, Moon, and Water
books.author: Athieno Gertrude
books.description: Dhopadhola myth explaining why the sun and the moon stay in the sky.

books.title: Sun, Moon, Rain and Wind
books.author: Khothatso Ranoosi
books.description: Sun, Moon, Rain and Wind cannot agree on who does the most for the earth. They have a meeting to decide, and come up with an interesting solution.

books.title: Super Mummy and Super Super!
books.author: Mimi Werna
books.description: This story explores the many roles a mother plays, and the importance of a supportive father.

books.title: Taolo's father and the giraffe
books.author: Pelonomi Itumeleng
books.description: The story is about a poor family in Gasehubane, Kuruman. The family is hungry and Taolo's father goes hunting. This storybook was created in 2022 as part of a collaborative project involving African Storybook, British Council (South Africa), and Department of Basic Education (DBE SA)

books.title: Thabani's spear
books.author: Khanyi Dubazana
books.description: Thabani receives a gift from his brother. It is a spear! Will Thabani have the courage to use his spear?

books.title: Thato's journey
books.author: Andreas Hurlimann
books.description: Thato's big sister is sick, and he has to buy groceries for them.

books.title: The baboons that went this way and that
books.author: Southern African Folktale
books.description: People in a small village moved to the hills to escape wild animals. They learn to survive on fruit and roots. They begin to look and behave like apes. The baboon families cannot live together anymore.

books.title: The bandit
books.author: DiresGebre-Meskel
books.description: About the dangers of being a travelling merchant, and the insight of a ruler who catches a murderer within the village. (This story was originally narrated by DiresGebre-Meskel. The English version was written by Elizabeth Laird.).

books.title: The boy who nobody loved
books.author: Phumy Zikode
books.description: An ugly boy goes into a forest to find a special root that a mysterious old lady promises to use to make him beautiful. In the forest, he is faced with many temptations.

books.title: The flying cake
books.author: Amaryllis Inauen
books.description: Bandile prepares a special birthday surprise for his friend. Then something went totally wrong. But he gets unexpected help. Will he be able to prepare the present in time?

books.title: The girl who got rich
books.author: Salaama Wanale
books.description: Two young girls go on journeys to find food. They both meet an old woman on the way, but only one agrees to help her.

books.title: The goat that ate the spinach
books.author: Claudine Van Rooyen
books.description: A story about naughty boys and a kind grandmother.

books.title: The hunter
books.author: John Ng'asike
books.description: Greed can lead to losing all. A hunter learns this lesson the hard way.

books.title: The jungle school
books.author: Madhav Chavan
books.description: The animals in the jungle rush to the new school with great enthusiasm. What do you think happened after that?

books.title: The kingfisher and the sea
books.author: Peter Omoko
books.description: Why does the kingfisher bird refuse to leave the river bank? (This story was created at a Story Making Workshop in Abuja, 2018, co-hosted by African Storybook and the British Council Nigeria).

books.title: The peace tree
books.author: Mpumelelo Mlangeni
books.description: We all need a place where we can find peace. (Story created by children at a July 2019 holiday workshop, facilitated by African Storybook at Pimville Library in Soweto).
books.illustrator: Tshiamo  Msimanga, Tumi  Mofokane, Mpumelelo  Mlangeni

books.title: The sick hyena
books.author: Mozambican folktale
books.description: Rabbit goes to visit his friend the hyena.

books.title: The sticky doll
books.author: Mozambican Folktale
books.description: Our friend Br'er Rabbit comes out the winner again!

books.title: The Sun Smiled
books.author: Khumo M
books.description: It's important to stop and think before we get angry with someone. (Story and illustrations created by children at a July 2019 holiday workshop, facilitated by African Storybook at Pimville Library in Soweto).

books.title: Three boxes of wealth
books.author: Angesom Abadi
books.description: A father leaves each of his sons an inheritance that best suits his talents.(This story was created at a teacher workshop in Adwa, Ethiopia, 2017, with Imagine1Day.).

books.title: Three truths of Hyena
books.author: Fary Silate Ka
books.description: He-Goat met Hyena on his way to pilgrimage. Hyena threatened to eat him, unless he gives her three truths. (This story was created at a Story Making Workshop in Abuja, 2018, co-hosted by African Storybook and the British Council Nigeria).

books.title: Thunder and Lightning
books.author: Athieno Gertrude
books.description: Thunder and her son, lightning, lived on earth amongst people. Due to her destructive, naughty son the king sent them to live in the sky away from people.

books.title: Tortoise finds his house
books.author: Maya Fowler
books.description: Tortoise is searching for his house. Do you know where he'll find it?

books.title: Undeelu!
books.author: Marcy Hessling O'Neil
books.description: This is the story of a mystic being who lives in the forest. He is able to feed himself using the magic word, "Undeelu." Undeelu is a folktale from Bénin Republic.
books.illustrator: Les Enfants De TSEF et de EPP Houeke Honou

books.title: Waiting for the bus
books.author: African Storybook
books.description: Why do buses never seem to keep to their schedule! Especially when it's time to go to town.

books.title: Walugo and the fishes
books.author: Paul Walugo
books.description: Walugo cannot resist the crunchy bits of friend fish!

books.title: Wardit, the mule
books.author: Mesfin Habte-Mariam
books.description: A traditional story that offers an explanation for why mules cannot produce offspring. (This story was originally narrated by Mesfin Habte-Mariam. The English version was written by Elizabeth Laird.).

books.title: Whoever doesn't obey elders
books.author: Yakubu Aliyu Malumri
books.description: It is about a boy who was disobedient to his elders. (This story was created at a Story Making Workshop in Abuja, 2018, co-hosted by African Storybook and the British Council Nigeria).

books.title: Why Hippos have no hair
books.author: Basilio Gimo
books.description: In this Nyungwe folktale, we see what happens when Hare refuses to forgive Hippo for stepping on his foot.

books.title: Why hyenas limp
books.author: Oda Wako Genale
books.description: This story offers a reason why hyenas have a strange way of walking. (The story was created at a story development workshop at Ras Abebe library in Debre Birhan in May 2018.).

books.title: Why is Nita upside down?
books.author: Roxana Bouwer
books.description: Nita's hanging upside down. Can she turn the right way round?

books.title: Why men have chest hair
books.author: Agnes Asamoah-Duodu
books.description: A proud child could not fulfil a promise she made to a river god, and she got drowned. (This story was created at a teacher workshop in Accra with OLE Ghana in 2017.).
books.illustrator: Andrews Opoku Antwi, Michelangelo Quaye Anang

books.title: Zethu's necklace
books.author: Nokuthula Ntshonga
books.description: Zethu wishes that her mother could buy her the necklace that she wants. (This storybook was originally created on the Maker App, and then re-published on the website. It was originally created at a storybook development workshop with 22 educators, in February 2019, in partnership with the British Council and the Department of Basic Education, South Africa).

books.title: Zìnzìnklézìn
books.author: Bienvenu Azehoungbo
books.description: Why are the panther and the cat no longer friends? Find out why in the story of a clever kitten named Zìnzìnklézìn. This story is based on a folktale from Bénin Republic.
books.illustrator: Les Enfants De TSEF et de EPP Houeke Honou

books.title: A Dancer's Tale: The Story of Phyllis Spira
books.author: Samantha Cutler
books.description: This is the story of the life of Phyliis Spira, from the time she was a young aspiring dancer, to her world travels, and finally her marriage and creation of dance schools in South Africa.

books.title: A Fish and a Gift
books.author: Liesl Jobson
books.description: Yusuf waits in anticipation for his father to return from fishing. He has promised to bring Yusuf a gift today.

books.title: Advice from an old man
books.author: Angesom Abadi
books.description: About the value of advice from elders. (This story was developed at a teacher workshop in Adwa, Ethiopia in 2017, with Imagine1Day.).

books.title: Africa Unity Race
books.author: Nina Orange
books.description: The story is about two young people who run across Africa to spread the message of unity. On the way, others to join the race.

books.title: Aku and her ice cream
books.author: Agnes Gyening-Asiedu
books.description: Aku is a greedy child who learns a bitter lesson.

books.title: Amara and animals
books.author: Judy B. Maranga
books.description: This is a story about a girl who loves her dog so much that she would do anything to protect it.

books.title: Anansi and Vulture
books.author: Ghanaian folktale
books.description: Anansi is poor, but his friend Rabbit is a prosperous farmer. Anansi is jealous, and finds a way to take over his friend's farm. He makes a lot of money selling Rabbit's fruit and vegetables. But one day on the way home from the market, something happens to change Anansi's fortunes again.

books.title: Bohlale's adventure
books.author: Gianna Ambrosano
books.description: Bohlale lives with her Gogo and her older brother and sister. Everyone always tells her that she is too young, too small, too weak and not brave enough yet. One night she has a dream. She goes on an adventure and everything changes...
books.illustrator: Gianna  Ambrosano, Laila  Wermelinger, Selina Buschor

books.title: Byantaka and the dead pot
books.author: Cornelius Wambi Gulere
books.description: Byantaka the herdsman had a small pot. He desired a bigger pot. What could he do? He used his head and got what he wanted. He tricked his neighbour … but that was not so kind.

books.title: Cat and Dog draw and colour
books.author: Elke and René Leisink
books.description: Cat and Dog are friends. They are funny and they enjoy doing all sorts of things together.

books.title: Children crossing!
books.author: Jacqueline Jacobs
books.description: A terrible accident finally brings a pedestrian crossing to this community. (This storybook was originally created on the Maker App, and then re-published on the website. It was originally created at a storybook development workshop with 22 educators, in February 2019, in partnership with the British Council and the Department of Basic Education, South Africa).

books.title: Clever brother
books.author: Mulualem Daba
books.description: Jealousy and stupidity can be a fatal combination! (This story was originally narrated by Merga Debelo. The English version was written by Elizabeth Laird.).

books.title: Clever Jackal and foolish Crow
books.author: Kholeka Mabeta
books.description: The hungry jackal sees Crow flying with a piece of cheese in his beak, looking for a tree to enjoy it. Jackal follows Crow and stays under the tree where the crow lands. Jackal makes small talk with Crow pretending to be friendly. What is the jackal's real mission?

books.title: Clever woman
books.author: Angesom Abadi
books.description: A clever wife helps her husband answer some important questions. (This story was developed at a teacher workshop in Adwa, Ethiopia in 2017, with Imagine1Day.).

books.title: Counting cabbages
books.author: Penelope Smith
books.description: A maths story about counting and sharing. (This storybook was made possible by funding from the Oppenheimer Memorial Trust.).

books.title: Counting cabbages (Colour-in)
books.author: Penelope Smith
books.description: Colour-in storybook. A maths story about counting and sharing. (This storybook was made possible by funding from the Oppenheimer Memorial Trust.).

books.title: Cows at the market
books.author: Ursula Nafula
books.description: A herd of cows wanders into a market, disrupting the business there. One woman takes it upon herself to complain and shout. In response, the cows have some complaints of their own.

books.title: Do not challenge God
books.author: Abem Mathias Katisongo
books.description: Aweh who put God to the test could not finish weeding his farm. Who is to blame?

books.title: Don't cross a flooded river!
books.author: Sea Rescue and Sean Verster
books.description: Every year people drown because they are swept off their feet while trying to cross a river that is flowing faster than usual after a lot of rain. (This storybook was created and published by the National Sea Rescue Institute (NSRI), using the African Storybook Maker App).

books.title: Drought and the River of Blessings
books.author: Mohammed Sale Also
books.description: A prolonged dry season led to a serious drought. Animals therefore used solidarity to overcome their common problem. (This story was created at a Story Making Workshop in Abuja, 2018, co-hosted by African Storybook and the British Council Nigeria).

books.title: Duma says wash your hands!
books.author: African Storybook
books.description: Duma is 10 years old. His community has been affected by coronavirus. Share what Duma has learned about how to protect yourself and others from getting sick.

books.title: Duma says wear a mask!
books.author: African Storybook
books.description: Duma is 10 years old. His community has been affected by coronavirus. Duma's sister, Zinhle, comes up with a plan to help protect the people living in the community.

books.title: Elders
books.author: Oku Modesto
books.description: The elders in this story are greedy for meat!

books.title: Elephant and Hippo
books.author: Terkule Aorabee
books.description: Why the two animals are close relations but live apart. It is good to help others.

books.title: Ernst and the Jackal
books.author: African Storybook
books.description: A thoughtful story about a jackal and a boy who help each other.

books.title: Father and daughters
books.author: Aberash Humna
books.description: What happens to two daughters when their father abandons them? (This story was created at a story development workshop at Ras Abebe library in Debre Birhan in May 2018).

books.title: Fati and the Honey Tree
books.author: Osu Library Fund
books.description: Every day is a new beginning for Fati, a little girl who tries very hard to do as she is told. In this story, Fati finds that climbing trees can lead to trouble. Fati and the Honey Tree is based on the real-life adventures of a girl growing up in northern Ghana.

books.title: Fati and the Soup Pot
books.author: Osu Library Fund
books.description: Fati has always been a fast runner, and proves this once again at her school's Sports Day. When she returns home from school, she helps her mother prepare okro soup. The soup smells delicious and Fati is tempted! Fati and the Soup Pot is based on the real-life adventures of a girl growing up in northern Ghana.

books.title: Fire on the mountain
books.author: African Storybook
books.description: What causes the fires that happen every year in Cape Town (ǁHui!gaeb)? According to the |Xam, it's the trees that become angry.
books.illustrator: Pule  KaJanolintshi, Carolina  Odman, Bernhard  Du Pont, Abu  Shawca, Fynbos  Guy, Zoudedrop, Christopher  Griner

books.title: First Man and First Woman
books.author: Southern African Folktale
books.description: A story about the beginning of the world and the first humans. They rise as snakes from the depths of a dark cold pool into a sunlit world of colour. As they move up to the surface the snakes change their form to start new lives.

books.title: Forest of snakes
books.author: Joseph Sanchez Nadimo
books.description: Three sisters go to the forest in search of firewood, but only two of the girls return home. What happens to the third sister?

books.title: Four lambs and a fox
books.author: Angesom Abadi
books.description: One should be careful in telling others a secret. (This story was developed at a teacher workshop in Adwa, Ethiopia in 2017, with Imagine1Day.).

books.title: Friends become enemies
books.author: Nelson Acadri
books.description: Will hardworking Hyena ever learn his lesson when it comes to his friend the lazy Hare?

books.title: Fruits talk in a basket
books.author: Diana Tebeila
books.description: The story is about fruits in the basket talking and boasting about who the chef will pick to make a fruit salad. This storybook was created in 2022 as part of a collaborative project involving African Storybook, British Council (South Africa), and Department of Basic Education (DBE SA)

books.title: Goat's Tail and Hyena's Spots
books.author: Terkule Aorabee
books.description: This story is derived from a Tiv folklore explaining why hyenas have spots and goats have short tails.

books.title: Goat, the false king
books.author: Cornelius Wambi Gulere
books.description: Now you know why goats are so stubborn!

books.title: Grandmother and the smelly girl
books.author: Southern African Folktale
books.description: A young girl's grandmother makes her a beautiful makgabe. Her friends are jealous and trick her.

books.title: Grateful animals
books.author: Mariam Mohammed
books.description: A story about the virtues of animals, and the vices of humans. (This story was originally narrated by Mariam Mohammed, in Borena. The English version was written by Elizabeth Laird).

books.title: Hare and Hyena
books.author: Mutugi Kamundi
books.description: Although they are friends, Hare benefits from Hyena's stupidity. But no matter how clever Hare is, he will not be able to fool Hyena forever.

books.title: Hare and Tortoise (Again!)
books.author: Venkatramana Gowda
books.description: Remember how the slow and steady tortoise beat the arrogant hare in that great race long ago? Now the two are back together again, and they have a task to complete. Can these two rivals work together?

books.title: Hen and Eagle
books.author: Ann Nduku
books.description: At one time, Hen and Eagle were good friends. Then Hen borrows a needle from Eagle, and the needle is lost. Eagle is so angry that she wants a terrible revenge.

books.title: Holiday experiences
books.author: Blessing Nemadziva
books.description: Mrs Clark gave her pupils a holiday assignment. Her pupils must draw what they enjoyed most during their holidays. The pupils draw some of the best tourist attractions in Africa.

books.author: Violet Otieno
books.description: Two children are excited as they prepare to visit their grandmother in her village. They enjoy life in the village so much that they don't want to leave.

books.title: How to use the Storybook Maker App

books.description: Hints and tips for making a storybook with children's artwork and the African Storybook Maker app.

books.title: How Zebra got his stripes

books.description: Brave Zebra saves the day. (This story was donated by LAPA Publishers.).

books.title: Hyena and Monkey
books.author: Elizabeth Laird
books.description: Who will solve the dispute between Hyena and Monkey? (A version of this story was collected from Bale and originally narrated by Mohammed Kuyu in Oromo. An English version was written by Elizabeth Laird.).

books.title: Hyena and Monkey (Colour-in)
books.author: Elizabeth Laird
books.description: Who will solve the dispute between Hyena and Monkey? (A version of this story was collected from Bale and originally narrated by Mohammed Kuyu in Oromo. An English version was written by Elizabeth Laird.).

books.title: Hyena and Raven
books.author: Ann Nduku
books.description: Hyena wants to know what the white mark is at the back of Raven's neck. On hearing that it is meat, he also wants to be able to fly into the clouds to get this 'meat'. He succeeds in flying, but it doesn't last and he falls to earth.

books.title: Hyena, Hare and their basins
books.author: Ursula Nafula
books.description: Hare never stops amazing other animals.

books.title: Jackal and the sun
books.author: Traditional San story
books.description: Lazy Jackal falls in love with the sun and wants to take her home to meet his father. They set off on the journey with Jackal carrying the sun on his back, but they don't get very far.

books.title: Kariza's questions
books.author: Aloysie Uwizeyemariya

books.author: Ursula Nafula
books.description: The story tells of Khayanga, a little girl whose parents died. Her loss and pain lead her to seek comfort from her parents' graves. She is miraculously given the gift of a special gourd, and through this gourd she experiences the presence of her parents.

books.title: Kidnapped!
books.author: Richard Khadambi
books.description: An exciting adventure story in which two boys are kidnapped for ransom.

books.title: King of the birds
books.author: South African Folktale
books.description: The birds want a king, but they have difficulty choosing. They decide that the bird that can fly highest will be made king. The African Vulture thinks he has won the contest, but a tiny bird tricks him. Do the birds get their king?

books.title: Let's ride on raindrops
books.author: Ndivhuho Mutsila
books.description: Water takes many forms over the course of the water cycle. This story imagines riding on drops of water starting as rain, flowing through the earth to the sea, and rising into the sky as water vapour. This storybook was inspired by 'Catch a ride on raindrops', published on StoryWeaver. (The writing and publishing of this storybook was made possible by funding from the Oppenheimer Memorial Trust).

books.title: Lion and Warthog
books.author: Judith Baker
books.description: Warthog frees Lion from a hunter's trap. What does Lion do in return?

books.title: Lion gets sick
books.author: Little Zebra Books
books.description: A traditional animal folktale from Mozambique.

books.title: Magical rainbow river
books.author: Mimi Werna
books.description: A mother tells her children, the story of how the rainbow came to be in the sky. (This story was created at a Story Making Workshop in Abuja, 2018, co-hosted by African Storybook and the British Council Nigeria).

books.title: Malasile and Wetsakhulya
books.author: Cornelius Wekunya
books.description: Malasile and Wetsakhulya were very good friends, until Malasile decided to test the depth of their friendship.

books.title: Man with a serious problem
books.author: Ursula Nafula
books.description: A man is generous enough to offer accommodation to his aging grandparents, aunt and uncle. Find out how life changes as time goes by.

books.title: Mod the toad
books.author: Alice Mulwa
books.description: This is the tale of why toads have bumpy backs and hide in cool, dark places.

books.title: Mother-in-law
books.author: Abiyot Legesse
books.description: The age-old story of difficulties between a mother and her daughter-in-law. (This story was originally narrated by Abiyot Legesse. The English version was written by Elizabeth Laird.).

books.title: Mr Mkhize's quarters
books.author: Lorato Trok
books.description: A story about quarters, and lunch. (This storybook was made possible by a grant from the Oppenheimer Memorial Trust.).

books.title: Mulongo and the Hyenas
books.author: Sarah Nangobi
books.description: Mulongo went into the forest to meet her friends. She took the wrong turn and got lost. Mulongo walked until she was tired, and fell asleep under a tree. She woke when it was dark, and hyenas were gathering around her. How will she get home safely?

books.title: Mulongo and the Ogre
books.author: Fabian Wakholi
books.description: There is a drought and Mulongo and his family are searching for food. They find a rich plantation and the owner lets them eat his crops. But they must pay a very high price for their food.

books.title: My first day at the market
books.author: Ursula Nafula
books.description: On Etabo's sixth birthday, his mother and aunt take him to town to visit the market for the first time.

books.title: My friend Coco

books.title: Namorutunga
books.author: Simon Ipoo
books.description: Namoratunga in Turkana, Kenya, is an ancient site of 19 stone pillars. This story explains how those stones came to be at the site.

books.title: Nangila's courage
books.author: Violet Otieno
books.description: Will Nangila succeed where big strong men have failed?

books.title: Nhimbe
books.author: Blessing Nemadziva
books.description: Nhimbe is a Zimbabwean custom where communities help each other doing work. The story focuses on the community helping Mbuya Sigauke weeding her field.

books.title: No Pigs Allowed
books.author: Basilio Gimo
books.description: Pig wants to go to the party, but only animals with horns are allowed in. What will he do?

books.title: Old rooster
books.author: Cissy Kiwanuka Luyiga
books.description: Four elderly animals join together to liberate themselves from their ungrateful owners.

books.title: Oscar's journey
books.author: Fabienne Zingg
books.description: Oscar, a little goat, goes on a journey to find his friend. On his way are some difficulties that he has to overcome. Will they ever be back together?

books.title: Otukolia fights Lingiri
books.author: Enzata Francis
books.description: Lingiri the monster overcomes all the people on earth. Will Otukolia be able to defeat the monster?

books.title: Our wonderful world
books.author: Herminder Ohri
books.description: A story about the creation of the world and humans.

books.title: People who forgot
books.author: Edwin Irabor
books.description: A certain village is at risk until a new leader comes along. (This story was created at a Story Making Workshop in Abuja, 2018, co-hosted by African Storybook and the British Council Nigeria).

books.title: Petros and his dog
books.author: Bethelihem Waltenegus
books.description: A sweet story about a new friendship between a boy and a loving dog.

books.title: Pheelamilo and the Monkeys
books.author: Pheedevah Abafalous (Helena Heritage Academy Workshop)
books.description: Monkeys have invaded the maize farms in Tuntunganga. Who will expel them and marry the princess?

books.title: Pick it up
books.author: Fanie Viljoen
books.description: Taking a stand against bullying. (This story was donated by LAPA Publishers.).

books.title: Picture story 16
books.author: Name Of Writer
books.description: A story without words, for you to write your own story

books.title: Pontshibobo's tree
books.author: Buhle Vilakazi
books.description: This story teaches us about true friendship.

books.title: Princess Asa
books.author: Seundede Kubeyinje
books.description: Asa becomes a princess! (ASb approved version of this community storybook).

books.title: Pumpkins?
books.author: Jacinta Recha
books.description: A man tells his children not to eat the pumpkins he planted. But the children don't listen.

books.title: Rabbit under the tree
books.author: Phumy Zikode
books.description: While Rabbit is sleeping under an apple tree, an apple falls to the ground. At the same time, Rabbit hears a voice shouting "Run rabbit run!" That's when the pandemonium starts!

books.title: Rat king's son
books.author: Merga Debelo
books.description: How does the greatest king in the world find a suitable wife for his son? (This story was originally narrated by Merga Debelo. The English version was written by Elizabeth Laird.).

books.title: Rebirth of a kingdom
books.author: Gabeba Brown
books.description: A story of adversity and triumph in harsh conditions. (The storybook was originally created on the African Storybook Maker App, and then re-published on the website. It was originally created at a storybook development workshop with 22 educators, in February 2019, in partnership with the British Council and Department of Basic Education, South Africa).

books.title: Result of disobedience
books.author: Addison Gifty Naana
books.description: Kwesi's sad day that led to the cutting of his leg. (This story was created at a teacher workshop in Accra with OLE Ghana in 2017.).
books.illustrator: Andrews Opoku Antwi, Michelangelo Quaye Anang

books.title: Sara's Canoe
books.author: Little Zebra Books
books.description: Sara is helping people and animals across the river in her canoe, but the elephant wants to cross, too!

books.title: Share it fair! (Colour-in)
books.author: Penelope Smith
books.description: Colour-in version. A maths story about the importance of sharing, even when it is difficult to work out exactly how to share fairly! (This maths storybook was made possible by funding from the Oppenheimer Memorial Trust.).

books.title: Sibusiso, the evil fairy
books.author: Pimville Library Soccer
books.description: An old woman with a stomach ache is unable to get to help. Sibusiso, the bad fairy, makes the situation even worse. (Story created by children at a July 2019 holiday workshop, facilitated by African Storybook at Pimville Library in Soweto).

books.title: Sinziro and his brothers
books.author: Magabi Eynew Gessesse
books.description: This story reminds us that it doesn't matter what size you are, it's a clever mind that wins the day.

books.title: Skeleton bones
books.author: African Storybook
books.description: This story introduces the human skeleton and its main bones in a fun way. It was inspired by 'Skeleton Puzzle', published on StoryWeaver. (The writing and publishing of this storybook was made possible by funding from the Oppenheimer Memorial Trust).

books.title: Sly Jackal tricks the silly Donkey
books.author: Kholeka Mabeta
books.description: Jackal falls into a well and his calls for help are heard by Donkey. Jackal tells Donkey that he wants someone to swim with him in the cool water. Donkey hesitates because he isn't good at swimming, but Jackal promises to help the donkey. Will sly Jackal keep his word?

books.title: Stay safe at the beach!
books.author: Sea Rescue and Sean Verster
books.description: There are dangerous currents at some beaches. They are called rip currents and can carry a person away from the beach very fast. This is why you should only swim at a beach that has lifeguards on duty, and swim between their flags. (This storybook was created and published by the National Sea Rescue Institute (NSRI), using the African Storybook Maker App).

books.title: Syonzola and his lies
books.author: Phoebe Sibomana
books.description: This is a children story about a brave son who saved his father from a vicious animal attack.

books.title: Ten lost boys
books.author: Felix Kwame Senanu
books.description: About the disobedience of ten young boys, and a puzzle.
books.illustrator: Andrews Opoku Antwi, Michelangelo Quaye Anang

books.title: Thakgalo's musical wheelchair
books.author: Diana Tebeila
books.description: This story dedicated to my disabled daughter, Thakgalo and to say, everyone is abled. It is about a disabled girl, the love of music, and good friends. This storybook was created in 2022 as part of a collaborative project involving African Storybook, British Council (South Africa), and Department of Basic Education (DBE SA)

books.title: The blacksmith's dilemma
books.author: Ugandan folktale
books.description: A local chief summoned a famous blacksmith to his palace. The chief wanted the blacksmith to build a real man out of steel, one who could cry tears, and bleed human blood. The blacksmith was alarmed by the chief's request. He knew he could not refuse the chief, but how was he to complete this impossible task?

books.title: The Hyena's funeral
books.author: Daniel Ewoi
books.description: The donkeys attend a hyena's funeral with good intentions. But the hyenas play a cruel trick.

books.title: The Land of No Old People
books.author: Cleofas Samo
books.description: This grim folktale from the Nyungwe people of Mozambique reminds us of the importance of having older people in our communities.

books.title: The prince who had no name
books.author: Kaka Gana Abba
books.description: The story is about a prince who was not given a name at birth. (This story was created at a Story Making Workshop in Abuja, 2018, co-hosted by African Storybook and the British Council Nigeria).

books.title: The rainbow cloud
books.author: Zanele Dlamini
books.description: The Story of Mkabayi and Mmama. Born a twin that must be sacrificed, Mkabayi faces a bully and scary ghosts. Will the bond with her sister Mmama save her?

books.title: The Seventh Sun: A Tribal Tale From Odisha, India
books.author: Indian Folktale
books.description: There was a time when there were seven suns in the sky.

books.title: The talking bag
books.author: Caroline Lentupuru
books.description: Three little girls meet a giant who pretends to need help with firewood.

books.title: The tree wife
books.author: Southern African Folktale
books.description: An old man has everything he wants – except a wife. So he carves one for himself out of a tree.

books.title: The witch who becomes a queen
books.author: Prudence Molwantwa
books.description: A lonely man invites a woman to move into the forest with him. Unknown to him, she is a witch.

books.title: Tito Kiti
books.author: Calystus Erebon
books.description: How does a little girl help her parents to recover their older daughter and to know who had wronged them?

books.title: Tselane and the giant
books.author: Lorato Trok
books.description: After Tselane's father died her mother wanted them to move to another village to start a new life. But Tselane didn't want to go, and her mother agreed to let her stay on her own.

books.title: Wayan and the turtles
books.author: African Storybook
books.description: Wayan lives in a fishing village. He goes on an adventure and a turtle teaches him about what plastic does to the ocean.

books.title: What is a kill switch?
books.author: Sea Rescue and Sean Verster
books.description: When people go on the water in a small boat with an engine, the person driving the boat should always use a kill switch. This clever switch is connected to the skipper's arm by a cord, and if the skipper pulls the cord, the boat's engine stops. (This storybook was created and published by the National Sea Rescue Institute (NSRI), using the African Storybook Maker App).

books.title: What is a lifejacket?
books.author: Sea Rescue and Sean Verster
books.description: Four fishermen go out to sea in their boat, and a huge wave hits them. The boat capsizes and they fall into the freezing sea water. Find out what happened next. (This storybook was created and published by the National Sea Rescue Institute (NSRI), using the African Storybook Maker App).

books.title: What is CPR?
books.author: Sea Rescue and Sean Verster
books.description: CPR is short for Cardio-Pulmonary Resuscitation. Knowing how to perform CPR can save a life if someone has stopped breathing. Zanele and Kenneth remembered their CPR lessons from school and helped to save a man who had a heart attack and stopped breathing. (This storybook was created and published by the National Sea Rescue Institute (NSRI), using the African Storybook Maker App).

books.title: What Vusi's sister said
books.author: Nina Orange
books.description: Vusi's granny gives him an egg to take to his parents. The egg is an important ingredient for his sister's wedding cake. But on the journey to his parents something happens to the egg, and Vusi's troubles begin.

books.title: Who can count to ten?
books.author: Athieno Gertrude
books.description: Who will be ruler of the animals after King Leopard steps down?

books.title: Why are flamingos pink?
books.author: African Storybook
books.description: This story has some interesting facts about these colourful birds that can live in very salty conditions. There is also vocabulary about birds and their habitats. This storybook was inspired by 'The dance of the flamingo', published on StoryWeaver. (The writing and publishing of this storybook was made possible by funding from the Oppenheimer Memorial Trust).

books.title: Why Donkey cries louder than Horse
books.author: Mohammed Iddrisu
books.description: Why does Donkey cry louder than Horse? Read and find out.

books.title: Why tortoises have no hair
books.author: Maxwell Abwamba
books.description: This folktale explains the reason why tortoises are bald.

books.title: Young Pasitau
books.author: Gaspah Emukuru Juma
books.description: One day while Pasitau and the other boys are out grazing cattle it starts to rain. The boys take shelter, and when the rain stops the cattle have wandered away. Pasitau goes in search of the animals.

books.title: A day in the life of Melokuhle
books.author: Nolulamo Mnyaka-Mngeni
books.description: A story about a baby girl called Melokuhle and her four-year-old brother Asante, who go to a play centre. This storybook is part of an educational pack for student teachers learning about language diversity and multilingualism in Early Childhood Care and Education (ECCE). You can find the full pack in the guide section of this website.

books.title: A Rainbow Tale
books.author: Mimi Werna
books.description: Udoo, Erdoo and Eryum listen to another tale about the rainbow's magic and its colours! (Also read the storybook, Magical Rainbow River).
books.illustrator: Edwin  Irabor, Jesse Breytenbach, Offei Tettey Eugene

books.title: Abike's day
books.author: Penelope Smith
books.description: This maths story explores multiplication, patterns, shapes and aspects of measurement, through the story of a day in the life of Abike, a ten-year old village girl.

books.title: Abla
books.author: African Storybook
books.description: Will Abla be able to go to school, or will she have to get married?

books.title: Aku the Sun Maker
books.author: Aisha Nelson
books.description: A dejected girl finds an unlikely friend and together, they bring life and joy to her town. (This story was created at a Story Making Workshop in Abuja, 2018, co-hosted by African Storybook and the British Council Nigeria).

books.title: An egg for bride wealth
books.author: Cornelius Wambi Gulere
books.description: A story is about a young man and an important egg, given to him by his grandmother. The young man is not very good at looking after this egg, but fortunately he has good luck.

books.title: Anansi and wisdom
books.author: Ghanaian folktale
books.description: The sky god decides to give Anansi the spider a pot of wisdom. He is so excited by all he learns from looking into it that he wants to hide it in a tree so that he can keep it all to himself. Unfortunately for him (but fortunately for the people of the world), the pot falls and breaks.

books.title: Anansi, the Crows, and the Crocodiles
books.author: Ghanaian folktale
books.description: Greedy Anansi tries to trick his friends the crows into giving him more than his fair share of figs. The crows uncover his tricks and abandon him on an island. He tries to fly, but lands in the river among hungry crocodiles. This seems like the end for Anansi, will he find a way out?

books.title: Andzani and Nsovo, the astronaut
books.author: Arnold Mushwana
books.description: Find out about stars, rockets and meteors with Andzani in outer space

books.title: Baby snatched by cranes
books.author: South African Folktale
books.description: A group of cranes sees a crying baby and they decide to take the baby away with them.

books.title: Crocodile in my body
books.author: Val Morris
books.description: Ntombi lives with a terrible disease and must take extra care of herself to keep well and strong. Her Gogo makes sure that Ntombi has the healthy food and medicine she needs to live a normal life.

books.title: Dima and Owl
books.author: Traditional San story
books.description: It is a time when only Owl has sun, water and fire, and life is very difficult for humans. Dima wants these things and makes a plan to take them from Owl.

books.title: Eagle's needle
books.author: Jaco Jacobs
books.description: Hen loses Eagle's family heirloom. (This story was donated by LAPA Publishers.).

books.title: Fruit
books.author: Shakira Bodio
books.description: There was a beautiful girl whom everyone wished to marry. In her family compound, there was a tree with delicious fruit. Her parents decided that their daughter would marry whoever visited them and stayed the whole day without eating any of the fruit. Who would pass the test to win the girl's hand in marriage?

books.title: Fruits of freedom
books.author: African Storybook
books.description: A village sets out to find independence.

books.title: Graca's dream
books.author: Melissa Fagan
books.description: The inspiring story of Graca Machel, and her dream to instill a love for reading and learning in the children of Mozambique and the rest of Africa. What will this book inspire you to do?
books.illustrator: Karlien de Villiers, Marike le Roux

books.title: Grandma's bananas
books.author: Ursula Nafula
books.description: The little girl is curious as she watches her grandma preparing to ripen bananas.

books.title: Hare and Hyena fight
books.author: Jane Tsharane
books.description: Why Hyena and Hare are not friends anymore.

books.title: How Stories Came to People
books.author: Ghanaian folktale
books.description: Long ago, the sky god kept all stories locked up in a wooden box. People asked clever Anansi to ask the sky god for the stories. T

books.title: How to help someone in water
books.author: Sea Rescue and Sean Verster
books.description: Sea Rescue volunteers learn that before they can help someone else, they must make sure they themselves will not be hurt. This is how you can help a friend who is in danger of drowning while still keeping yourself safe. (This storybook was created and published by the National Sea Rescue Institute (NSRI), using the African Storybook Maker App).

books.title: Katitu Momambo, the clever little girl
books.author: Traditional San story
books.description: Katitu Momambo uses her wits to save herself and her sisters from a big snake. But later, her sisters abandon her in a well and she is swallowed by an elephant. How will Katitu save herself?

books.title: Kato Clever and the Big Trouble
books.author: Herminder Ohri
books.description: Kato the squirrel's family lived in a garden. One day, some people came there with machines to cut down the trees. How did Kato and his friends save themselves from this 'big trouble'?

books.title: King Kayanja and his daughter
books.author: Amana Yunus
books.description: A tragic love story about a beautiful young princess who follows her heart, rather than her father's wishes.

books.title: Lazy Anansi
books.author: Ghanaian folktale
books.description: The reason why spiders have long thin legs.

books.title: Let's fly!
books.author: Maria Vaz
books.description: A child imagines flying and embarks on a flight of imagination. This story is a simple introduction to flight and aeroplanes. It was inspired by 'How do aeroplanes fly', published on StoryWeaver. (The writing and publishing of this storybook was made possible by funding from the Oppenheimer Memorial Trust)

books.title: Lion's fire sticks (Level 5)
books.author: Traditional San story
books.description: In the beginning of time only the lion had the power of fire, using his fire sticks. The other animals and people decide they also want the benefits of fire, and make plans to steal the fire sticks.

books.title: Little Jojo's long tall tale
books.author: Leo Daly
books.description: The Chief of the Village of Many Shapes has lost the special horn that he blows to start the springtime party. Little Jojo goes in search of the missing horn, but can he find it?

books.title: Little mouse with fur
books.author: Zanele Ndlovu
books.description: A tale of a mouse with fur and a computer mouse. This storybook was inspired by 'Two mice', published on StoryWeaver. (The writing and publishing of this storybook was made possible by funding from the Oppenheimer Memorial Trust)

books.title: Lynne's birthday surprise
books.author: Leo Daly
books.description: Lynne has done a lot of work getting things ready for her birthday party, but will a burnt cake ruin everything? (Also available in Level 2).

books.title: Magezi and the finger of millet
books.author: Cornelius Wambi Gulere
books.description: A humorous tale about friendship and the clever gains from a finger of millet.

books.title: Magozwe
books.author: Lesley Koyi
books.description: A boy finds himself on the street with other street children. This is a thoughtful, challenging story about his life and how it begins to change for the better.

books.title: Mr Motaung's thirds
books.author: African Storybook
books.description: A story about thirds, and lunch. (This storybook was made possible by a grant from the Oppenheimer Memorial Trust.).

books.title: Mr Motaung's thirds (Colour-in)
books.author: African Storybook
books.description: Colour-in storybook. A story about thirds, and lunch. (This storybook was made possible by a grant from the Oppenheimer Memorial Trust.).

books.title: Namukhaywa
books.author: Ursula Nafula
books.description: Namukhaywa and her husband have 6 daughters, and he really wants a son. When she gives birth to a twin boy and girl she decides to hide her 7th daughter and only takes the son home to her husband. The twins grow up with separate lives, but one day they meet. Will they discover the truth?

books.title: Ndalo and Pendo – The best of friends
books.author: Penelope Smith
books.description: Ndalo helps his father to look after Pendo the family cow in exchange for pocket money that he uses to buy books for himself.

books.title: Nomfundo and the forest animals
books.author: Lorato Trok
books.description: Nomfundo visits the forest canopy and meets some of the animals who live there.

books.title: Nonkungu and the imbulu
books.author: Alan Kenyon
books.description: Nonkungu was going to visit her uncle and her mother gave her beautiful clothes to wear. On the way to her uncle's village, Nonkungu meets a strange girl who wants to wear the lovely clothes.

books.title: Our environment, our responsibility!
books.author: Rebecca Njuguna
books.description: River Temu flourished and was a source of life for both people and animals until Matata ruined it. Fortunately, before it is too late, the area is revived by a new leader.

books.title: Pam-Pam bird
books.author: Pensa Limungu
books.description: The hunter learns a valuable lesson from the Pam-Pam bird about the need for co-operation between humans and animals.

books.title: Polygon family
books.author: Lindiwe Tshabalala
books.description: Maths story about shape families. (This storybook was made possible by funding from the Oppenheimer Memorial Trust.).

books.title: Queen of Soweto: The Story of Basetsana Kumalo
books.author: Jessica Taylor
books.description: Basetsana Kumalo is a beauty queen, but she's also so much more. She teaches us that true beauty is about having a heart filled with love and generosity. Her story shows us that if you have courage and determination, you can achieve your dreams –whatever they may be.

books.title: Refiloe and the washed chickens
books.author: Marion Drew
books.description: Refiloe's sister is getting married. Refiloe's chickens are very dirty and she decides to wash them for the wedding. The chickens do not like being washed. Refiloe cannot find her chickens when it is time for the wedding, and everyone is in for a big surprise.

books.title: Searching for the spirit of Spring
books.author: Mosa Mahlaba
books.description: Nkanyezi can't wait for the Spring festival, but the people of Ndlovu have lost their spirit of celebration.

books.title: Sekuru Mkuku
books.author: Blessing Nemadziva
books.description: Farai, a city boy, was unhappy when his parents sent him on holiday to his grandparents in the rural areas. But by the end of the holiday, he had changed his mind.

books.title: Sentence Street
books.author: Mimi Werna
books.description: This story introduces you to 9 punctuation marks.

books.title: Share it fair!
books.author: Penelope Smith
books.description: A maths story about the importance of sharing, even when it is difficult to work out exactly how to share fairly! (This maths storybook was made possible by funding from the Oppenheimer Memorial Trust.).

books.title: Simbegwire
books.author: Rukia Nantale
books.description: After Simbegwire's mother died, she and her father did everything together. They were happy until Simbegwire's father wanted to marry a new wife. This woman treats the girl badly, and Simbegwire runs away from home.

books.title: Sisanda's gift
books.author: Gcina Mhlophe
books.description: Sisanda has a special gift for a new friend. (This story was donated by Gcina Mhlophe, and pictures by Jiggs Snaddon-Wood. It was first published by Nal'ibali -- http: //nalibali. Org/).

books.title: Sizwe's smile
books.author: Vianne Venter
books.description: Sizwe helps brighten up a rainy day with his smile around town.

books.title: Skillful musicians
books.author: Athieno Gertrude
books.description: A story about musical instruments of the Jopadhola people of Uganda. It indicates the roles of the different musical instruments in the Jopadhola culture.

books.title: The Animals Dig a Well
books.author: Francisco Escondido
books.description: All the animals except Rabbit dig a well. Rabbit gets into his characteristic mischief.

books.title: The baboons that went this way and that
books.author: Sheila Drew
books.description: People in a small village moved to the hills to escape wild animals. They learn to survive on fruit and roots, and they begin to look and behave like apes. Then these baboon families find that they no longer want to live together.

books.title: The boy and the jackal
books.author: Ernst Swartbooi
books.description: About a jackal who helps a helpful boy.

books.title: The generous fish
books.author: Kholeka Mabeta
books.description: Nosisa lives with her mother and father in a small village. Her father treats her mother badly, and she runs away, leaving her daughter. Nosisa's father marries again and the new wife is cruel to Nosisa. One day the girl takes refuge at a local stream and meets a fish that will change her life.

books.title: The Honeyguide's revenge
books.author: Zulu folktale
books.description: A young hunter follows a honey-guide bird to a bees' hive full of ripe honey. Instead of rewarding the bird with a share of the honey, he chases it away. The next time the young man tries to find honey, the bird gets its revenge!

books.title: The Rain Bird
books.author: Nal'ibali
books.description: There lived a beautiful bird deep in the forest, a bird that made the rain fall.

books.title: The smell thief
books.author: Joanne Bloch (retold folktale)
books.description: A baker objects to people smelling his delicious buns, bread and cakes without buying them. He gets so angry at these 'smell thieves' that he takes one of the frequent 'offenders' to court. Justice is done in a way that makes the baker reflect on himself.

books.title: Thimba to the rescue!
books.author: Penelope Smith
books.description: Thimba asks the villagers to help Gobani the Gentle Giant by making things the right size for him.

books.title: Thoko's FantaPine seed
books.author: Khothatso Ranoosi
books.description: One day Thoko throws a FantaPine tin into his father's field. His father is extremely angry. Fortunately, Thoko thinks carefully, and this story has a happy ending.

books.title: Unwise judge
books.author: Magabi Eynew Gessesse
books.description: Two men twice accept the advice of a bad judge. It is only when they eventually consult the elders, who listen carefully to their story, that the men can restore their friendship. (This story was originally narrated by Magabi Eynew Gessesse. The English version was written by Elizabeth Laird.).

books.title: Upside down world
books.author: William Gumede
books.description: The sun decides to stay up long after bedtime, and the world is turned upside-down.

books.title: Waiting for baby
books.author: Penelope Smith
books.description: A maths story. Thabi's mother has gone to hospital to have a baby. The maths themes developed in this story, focus on measurement; on length in metres and centimetres and time in days, hours and months.

books.title: When the big blue bus was late
books.author: Penelope Smith
books.description: Bubu and his mother are waiting for the big blue bus to take them to town.

books.title: Why do we need bees?
books.author: African Storybook
books.description: Reabetswe and Rebone visit the National Botanical Gardens. It turns out to be a competition about who knows the most about these useful insects. This story was inspired by 'Why do bees buzz?', published on StoryWeaver. (The writing and publishing of this storybook was made possible by funding from the Oppenheimer Memorial Trust).

books.title: Why Fly pesters Cow
books.author: Jaco Jacobs
books.description: A tiny animal with an irritating buzz! (This storybook was donated by LAPA publishers.).
